items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: We put Angelo, we had Angelo Palmasana after that.

ctx.x: He plays more than anybody that they got in the orchestra. But with all due respect to him, he's done shows. He's done, he's done, I don't know how many different shows in New York. And he knows what he's, he's not kidding you. He's not a bullshooter. Did Nappy leave the band
at the same time that Eddie did then? Nappy left us when we left the Edgewater. No, Eddie came with us. We put Angelo, we had Angelo Palmasana after that. Bernie's been very sick lately. Huh?
